question: Can the Atlas construct a checked ordinary dominating set of at most 15 vertices for the canonical order-48 TxGraffiti graph, while refusing an invalid independent-to-ordinary lower-bound transfer and preserving the limits of a failed transversal search?
selection: A real existing release, an exact finite object, a plausible but invalid strengthening, and an external graph-to-SAT bridge with a cheap finite test. Selected before executing the new search. Not a novel general theorem campaign.

queries: Gupta cubic graphs 48 domination edge domination 2026

sources.finding: The endpoint-transversal SAT equivalence is explicit. The order-48 theorem imports the minimum unsatisfiable (3,2,2)-formula classification; this pilot will instead enumerate the actual formula and verify its witness without that dependency.
Ordinary domination 16 is claimed for the different 50-vertex graph. A failed transversal is not itself an ordinary-domination lower bound.
Canonical 48-vertex graph and 15-edge matching. Independent domination is recorded as 16; ordinary domination is not determined here.

priorArt.decision: Proceed as a constructive method-transfer and falsification pilot. Do not claim a new order-48 theorem or priority. Search is bounded, not exhaustive; imported preprints are not independently verified general theorems.

comparison.baseline: Release text / similarity navigation supplies i(G)=16 and mu*(G)=15, but no ordinary dominating-set witness. A direct enumeration of all 15-subsets would have binomial(48,15) candidates; this is a search-space comparison, not a runtime trial against a competent solver.
comparison.intervention: Explicit endpoint-transversal reformulation, hypothesis checks, bounded exhaustive Boolean search, reconstruction and a separate graph-only witness checker.
success: Produce a dominating set with at most 15 distinct vertices checked from raw edges
Reject invalid lower-bound transfer and corrupt witnesses
On a negative control, distinguish no transversal from no dominating set
Removing the bridge leaves the route unavailable rather than hallucinating a certificate
comparison.failure: If no witness or useful obstruction is obtained, retain a null result. Do not replace this pilot silently or call documentation a research gain.
comparison.limit: One selected internal pilot, no blinded comparison, no causal acceleration or novelty claim. This tests practical route execution, not all nine discovery methods.
